description: Token provider (MCPWARP.md §5.2, §6.2 check 4; CLIENT-SDK.md Rejected token row): the token is a provider, called per dial. A close 4011 before welcome is not fatal the first time: the SDK calls the provider once more and redials at once, onRetry {attempt 1, delayMs 0, reason "token-refresh"}; as a pre-welcome failure it is connecting + RETRYING (T27), and the refreshed dial goes online. After stop() a new configure() starts a new transport with a fresh refresh budget: an observable 401 on the upgrade gets the same one refresh, and a second rejection is error/UNAUTHORIZED.
